license: internal · single-writer integration pending ARIF verdict
principle: Each verdict word has a unique consequence_class. Descriptive label != authorization token. Conflation is a constitutional violation.
transition_invariants: non-terminal states may NOT trigger irreversible execution
terminal states MUST be sealed before any mutation
HOLD and VOID are absolute block; SABAR is temporal block; PARTIAL is bounded execution
AUTHORIZED + VERIFIED => SEAL (both required for irreversible)

states.name: HEALTHY
states.operational_state: pre-execution integrity check passed; schema compliance verified

states.name: DRYRUN_ACCEPTED
states.operational_state: technical feasibility confirmed without mutation; safe simulation complete

states.name: SUCCEEDED
states.operational_state: event completion logged; historical fact; NOT unverified intent
forbidden_implications: this is not AUTHORIZATION for live deployment

states.name: VERIFIED
states.operational_state: cryptographic or empirical validation achieved; epistemic check passed

states.name: AUTHORIZED
states.operational_state: human or algorithmic permission explicitly granted; contract signed
forbidden_implications: AUTHORIZED alone is NOT a SEAL — VERIFIED also required

states.name: SEAL
states.operational_state: verified execution authorized strictly within a sealed scope; mutation permitted within scope

states.name: PARTIAL
states.operational_state: subset verified; proceed only within verified bounds

states.name: SABAR
states.operational_state: deliberate cooling pause; neither refusal nor approval; wait period enforces temporal friction
forbidden_implications: SABAR is not a soft YES; cooling must elapse before re-evaluation

states.name: HOLD
states.operational_state: human authority required; the agent MUST stop; absolute human veto invoked

states.name: VOID
states.operational_state: invalid proposal; rejected; do not retry without new evidence
forbidden_implications: retrying a VOID proposal without new evidence is a constitutional violation

conflation_detector.rule: two states MUST NOT share a consequence_class

single_writer_rule: Kimi/FI-008 = canonical writer for this vocabulary schema; ARIF = acceptance authority; no concurrent mutator.
